entities.summary: Pnina Tamano-Shata is an Israeli lawyer, journalist, and politician. The first Ethiopian-born woman to enter the Knesset in 2013, in 2020 she also became the first Ethiopian-born Israeli cabinet member after being appointed Minister of Immigrant Absorption.
